title: Timeless Classic Movies
intro: These films carry the kind of tension that doesn't age. Pull up a chair and let the classics crack you open.

films.title: Sunset Boulevard
films.line: A desperate man walks into a mansion and never really walks back out.

films.title: Vertigo
films.line: Obsession and illusion spiral together until you can't tell them apart.

films.title: The Third Man
films.line: A shadowy city holds a secret that will rewrite everything you trusted.

films.title: All About Eve
films.line: Ambition wears the most disarming smile in the room and never blinks.

films.title: Rashomon
films.line: Four people witnessed the same event and every single one of them lied.

films.title: Double Indemnity
films.line: A perfect plan between two people who should never have trusted each other.

films.title: Chinatown
films.line: Every answer you find only deepens the darkness waiting underneath.

films.title: Rope
films.line: Two men hide an unthinkable secret beneath the dinner party of the century.

films.title: Rear Window
films.line: Trapped and restless, he watches his neighbors until one window changes everything.
